rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for illness or the state of being sick.

example.english: This sickness has kept me in bed for several days.
example.traditional: 呢場病搞到我瞓咗幾日床。
example.jyutping: nei1 coeng4 beng6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 zo2 gei2 jat6 cong4

rows.note: Use this specifically for nausea or a sick feeling in the stomach.

example.english: I felt a bit of sickness after eating that bowl of fish balls.
example.traditional: 食完嗰碗魚蛋，我有啲噁心。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 go2 wun2 jyu4 daan6 ngo5 jau5 di1 ngok3 sam1
